chrome_hint: eBay AU and UK sold listings (Terapeak): 'Copeland parian Clytie bust', 'parian Clytie bust Art Union', 'parian bust Clytie 22cm', 'Victorian parian bust young woman'; note marked vs unmarked and size 20-25 cm, condition. Also LiveAuctioneers and Invaluable results for 'Clytie parian bust', Gowans/Leonard Joel/Lawsons/Mossgreen past results, WorthPoint 'Copeland parian Clytie'. Also check whether unmarked examples sell below marked Copeland ones.
viewing_check: Turn it over: look for impressed or incised marks on the back, socle or underside (Copeland, Art Union of London, Minton, Robinson & Leadbeater, date letters, title 'Clytie'). Inspect the brown spot on the shoulder, and look for chips, cracks, restoration and hairline damage on the petals and nose. Measure height and check the base is original.
